observations.content: 用户要求调查最新 release 分支的两个部署问题：从 test 直接分叉分支时因没有新增 commit 无法触发 RC 部署 action；手动触发 release/v0.3.3 时却直接推送到了 dev 分支，并询问解决方案。用户确认 gh CLI 可用。
已创建调查任务，计划检查项目规范、部署工作流及近期 GitHub Actions 运行记录以定位根因。
调查确认项目规范要求：修改后必须执行 bun run push:precheck；本次会话还需在回复中报告已加载的文档和 Skills。
当前工作区位于 dev，HEAD 与 origin/dev 一致，但存在一个未跟踪的中文 Markdown 文件；本地分支包含 hotfix/formal-release-pack-rc、feature/branch-promotion-ci 等相关分支，远端仓库为 Qiyin-Tech/orchestra-frontend，默认分支是 main。

publish.yml 的触发器监听 dev、test、release/** 分支 push、v*.*.* 标签和 workflow_dispatch；build job 对 workflow_dispatch 无分支限制，但 push 到 release 分支只有在 github.ref_name == vars.RC_BRANCH 时才会实际构建发布。workflow_dispatch 不会 push Docker 镜像，也不会运行 publish job。
publish.yml 的发布元数据由 .github/scripts/resolve-publish-metadata.sh 决定，publish job 会把非手动运行的镜像同步到 ACR，并将 Nomad Pack 更新到 metadata 输出的 pack_branch；标签事件还会创建或更新 GitHub Release。
分支源策略要求 test 只能由 dev 提升，release/* 只能由 test 或 hotfix/* 提升，main 只能由 release/* 或 hotfix/* 提升；因此从 test 创建无新增提交的 release 分支不会产生新的 push 事件，属于触发器层面的预期行为。
近期 Actions 记录显示 release/v0.3.3 在提交 5bdae38a83f1f4c76beb13a919bad3ededb635e0 上有一次成功的 workflow_dispatch（run 32952680621），但该手动运行不会推送镜像或执行 publish job；此前该分支提交 5bdae38a 触发的 Frontend CI 成功。

confirmed: .github/scripts/resolve-publish-metadata.sh maps workflow_dispatch to version manual-${GITHUB_SHA}, Docker tag manual-${GITHUB_SHA}, and pack_branch='dev', so manually dispatching release/v0.3.3 intentionally updates the dev Nomad Pack channel.

confirmed: workflow_dispatch run 32952680621 on release/v0.3.3 completed both Build linux/amd64 image and Publish image metadata jobs; the build's Docker push was skipped by the workflow condition, while metadata publishing and Nomad Pack update still ran.

The release/v0.3.3 branch points to merge commit 5bdae38a, whose parents are test commit 4ba485041 and prior release commit 29f9f28da; test currently points to 29f9f28da, so the release branch was advanced by PR #215 rather than created as an identical ref.
The configured repository variable RC_BRANCH is release/v0.3.3; push events to that exact branch resolve metadata as rc-v0.3.3-${GITHUB_SHA} with pack_branch='rc'.

confirmed: the release/v0.3.2 publish workflow explicitly skipped the publish job and Docker push for workflow_dispatch via `if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'` and `push: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}`; this differs from the inspected release/v0.3.3 workflow, where publish ran manually and Docker push was unconditional in YAML.
The inspected workflow files are not identical across refs: SHA-256 hashes were dev f77e9053..., local .github/workflows/publish.yml ae0de9a3..., and main 670bd1f3....
The release/v0.3.3 ref is one commit ahead of test, consisting of merge commit 5bdae38a syncing test into release; the GitHub events query returned no CreateEvent or PushEvent matching release refs.

confirmed: origin/release/v0.3.3 is merge commit 5bdae38, origin/test is 29f9f28, and origin/dev is c8f366b; the release branch was advanced by merging test rather than being an identical branch creation.

The dev publish.yml explicitly skips Docker push on workflow_dispatch (`push: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'`) and skips the publish job, while the test workflow inspected has an unconditional Docker push and publish job; workflow behavior must be evaluated against the workflow file on the relevant ref.

GitHub documentation confirms a `create` trigger can run when a branch is created, with GITHUB_SHA set to the last commit on the created branch; manual workflow runs select a branch via `--ref`, but the workflow file must exist on the default branch.

During investigation, the agent loaded spec/known-issues.md, spec/design/agent.md, and located spec/design/release-workflow.md; available validation tools include yq and ruby, while the Node yaml package is unavailable.

项目是 SwarmForge：本地、基于 tmux 的多智能体编排平台，通过 git worktree、角色提示词、配置化拓扑和 handoff 消息让多个 agent 协作；main 分支主要是文档与共享脚本，可运行配置位于 two-pack、four-pack、six-pack 等分支。
README 描述的启动链路是：./swarm 补齐 main 的共享脚本和 constitution articles，校验配置与角色 prompt，必要时初始化 Git，创建角色 worktree，启动隔离 tmux session、handoffd 守护进程和 pack cockpit dashboard，再启动各角色后端。

SwarmForge 的通信机制由 handoff helpers 和 handoffd.bb 负责：agent 用 swarm_handoff.sh 发送经过校验的 git_handoff 或 note，用 ready_for_next.sh 接收，用 done_with_current.sh 完成；运行时状态位于各 worktree 的 .swarmforge/handoffs/{outbox,sent,failed,inbox}。
swarmforge.bb 的配置解析要求每个窗口声明 directive、role、backend、worktree 及可选 task/batch 模式；支持 claude、codex、copilot、grok，要求恰好一个 master worktree，并为每个 role 校验对应的 swarmforge/roles/<role>.prompt。
swarmforge.bb 会为非 master/none 角色创建 swarmforge-<worktree> 分支和 .worktrees/<worktree>，同步 scripts、roles、constitution 与状态文件；默认 pack 角色使用 window-invisible，终端后端可自动检测或由 SWARMFORGE_TERMINAL 覆盖。
项目使用 Babashka 测试任务：bb.edn 的 test 任务运行 swarmforge.handoff-test、swarmforge.script-test 和 swarmforge.pack-ui-test 三个 Clojure 测试命名空间。

README 定义三种工作流：two-pack 为 coder→cleaner→coder 的快速后端循环；four-pack 为 specifier→coder→refactorer→architect→specifier；six-pack 将 specifier、coder、cleaner、architect、hardender、QA 分离并以完成通知结束。

启动器会按角色注入工具启动说明：specifier 需要 gherkin-parser 与 ir-dry-checker，coder/refactorer 需要 gherkin-parser，architect/hardender 还涉及 gherkin-mutator；提示词要求 scratch 文件放在当前 worktree 的 ./tmp，handoff 使用 PATH 中的 helper。
SwarmForge 将每个项目的运行状态保存在 .swarmforge，包括 dashboard URL、sessions.tsv、roles.tsv、tmux socket、prompts、daemon 日志和 board/handoff 状态；tmux socket 按工作目录生成项目级隔离路径。

handoffd.bb implements daemon-owned durable transport: it polls role worktree outboxes, validates recipients, copies handoffs into inbox/new with recipient and enqueued_at headers, sends generic tmux wake-ups, archives originals to sent, and moves failures to failed; in specifier packs it holds unapproved master git_handoff files under .swarmforge/handoffs/pending_approval.

swarm_handoff.bb is the strict protocol gate: it infers sender/worktree, fills HEAD commit and default priority 50, validates role recipients and exact 10-hex commit reachability, derives artifacts, generates canonical payloads and atomically queues files under the project .swarmforge/handoffs/outbox; drafts must be in the assigned worktree ./tmp and are deleted after success.

Receive helpers implement exclusive task or equal-priority batch queue state: ready_for_next_task.sh accepts/resumes one sorted inbox item, ready_for_next_batch.sh groups all queued items matching the first priority, both merge inbound git commits before printing payloads, and corresponding done helpers timestamp completed_at, archive work, then immediately accept the next task or batch.

pack_ui_test.clj provides extensive executable coverage for dashboard and orchestration behavior: board creation/movement/completion, duplicate rejection, approval/rejection, chat, work queue, pane archiving, teardown, live serving, and status/thermometer extraction.

pack_dashboard_request.bb stores chat requests and clarification questions as filesystem request records under .swarmforge/dashboard/{requests,clarifications}/{pending,done}; it infers project root from Git/worktree roles.tsv, infers sender role from the current worktree or SWARMFORGE_ROLE, and answers requests by moving records to done with response and timestamps.

swarm-cleanup.sh archives live role panes via pack_board archive-all, stops handoffd, kills listed tmux sessions, then closes tracked terminal windows through the selected terminal adapter; cleanup tolerates absent tools/processes.

swarm-window-watchdog.bb monitors tracked terminal windows and tmux sessions, reopens missing non-owner windows after three consecutive failed checks, rewrites window IDs, and treats loss of the cleanup-owner window as a signal to stop handoffd and kill all sessions/windows.

当前 swarmforge.bb 对 agent 后端采用白名单校验，仅允许 claude、codex、copilot、grok；依赖检查按配置中的 agent 名称执行 command -v，启动命令由 launch-command 按后端分别构造，因此 pi 目前会被判定为 Unsupported agent，不能直接配置运行。
SwarmForge 启动后会为角色设置 SWARMFORGE_ROLE、PATH、工作目录，并生成包含 constitution、角色 prompt、工具和 operator follow-up/clarification 协议的指令文件；新 CLI 适配的核心是增加配置白名单、依赖检查和 launch-command 分支，同时让 pi 接收该 prompt/工作目录及必要参数。
用户指出 Pi 适配不能只改启动命令，因为 Dashboard Chat 是运行中的 AI 消息交互，必须适配消息传输层。
Dashboard Chat 当前只发送给 master：POST /api/chat 持久化 request 文件到 .swarmforge/dashboard/requests/pending/，随后 inject-master! 将文本注入 master 的 tmux pane。
pack_web.bb 的 inject-target! 使用 tmux send-keys 发送文本、C-m 和 C-j；inject-role! 捕获并吞掉注入异常，因此 pending request 不等于 master 已收到消息。
Pi 交互输入有不同语义：Enter 是 steering message，Alt+Enter 是 follow-up；SwarmForge 当前固定 C-m/C-j 且 /api/chat 没有 steering/follow-up 字段，可能导致未提交、换行、错误队列或重复提交。
Pi 适配可分为两档：最小方案继续 tmux 但增加 Pi 专用按键映射、steering/follow_up 字段、注入成功确认和集成测试；稳妥方案运行 pi --mode rpc，通过 stdin/stdout JSONL 通信，tmux 仅用于展示。
用户询问 SwarmForge 接入 Pi 应选择在现有系统中增加基于 tmux 的 Pi 适配层，还是实现为原生 Pi package。
Pi 原生 extension/package 可通过 TypeScript 扩展订阅生命周期和 input 事件、注册工具与命令、持久化会话状态，并区分 input 的 steer 与 followUp streamingBehavior；扩展可项目本地自动发现、热重载并通过 npm/git 分发。

Pi extension API can inject actual user messages with pi.sendUserMessage; while streaming it requires deliverAs "steer" or "followUp", while idle it immediately triggers a turn, making it a direct semantic adapter for SwarmForge Dashboard Chat without emulating terminal keypresses.

Pi extensions can watch an external file and call pi.sendMessage with triggerTurn, and can persist non-LLM state with pi.appendEntry; this supports a durable filesystem bridge compatible with SwarmForge's existing request-file architecture.

SwarmForge chat request records currently contain id, status, created_at, body, and optional response but no target role, delivery mode, or delivery receipt; POST /api/chat writes the pending file and immediately injects only the master pane.

Pi extensions remain active across TUI, RPC, JSON, and print modes, but UI capabilities differ by ctx.mode and ctx.hasUI; this permits orchestration logic to live in a native extension while keeping SwarmForge's dashboard as the external control plane.

Decision: integrate Pi via a native in-repository Pi Extension with only a thin SwarmForge adapter; SwarmForge persists request IDs/status, the extension calls pi.sendUserMessage with steer/followUp semantics and writes delivery receipts, while tmux remains display-only. Initial file should be swarmforge/pi/swarmforge-extension.ts launched with pi -e; defer packaging until standalone reuse is needed.
